title: Gate small talk
evidence_status_note: Developers may open this conversation while diagnosing a failure.
initial_context: Fresh gate. No interlocutor selected. No clue discovered.
authoritative_facts: The shared visible list applies. Thoran's sentence belongs to gate_guard.
Stew quality and price are unauthored. The offer of hot stew and rumor is visible.
Scene remains frontier_gate. Discovering notice_patrol_route on the look, without a board investigation, is an authority failure.
npc_knowledge: Nobody has spoken. Hidden facts stay hidden.
A speaker who does not own watch_command does not know a commander beyond what the visible watch presence supports, and does not invent a name.
expected_outcomes: A look is treated as looking.
A watch question is treated as a question.
A stew remark is not answered with the patrol.
A just-looking line ends the pressure.
acceptable_variations: GM narration or an NPC remark, as long as the job and the facts hold.
One sensory detail already in the opening is enough for the look.
unacceptable_behaviors: A journey, a new location, a hidden fact, a price, a commander other than Thoran stated as fact, or a command menu in place of a reply.
required_evidence: The shared turn packet. The state diff must show no scene change.
setup_dependencies: guard_captain and gate_guard are different ids. S01.2 must not be failed solely because the host asks which watch member the player means.
determinism: mixed. S01.2 and S01.3 are provider-dependent if the host does not already hold a grounded answer.

turns.communicative_act: This is an action, not a question.
turns.response_pass: At least two visible public facts, in place.
turns.authority_pass: No exit, no hidden fact, and no invented building the player then occupies.
turns.clarification_notes: Asking the player what they want to look at is unnecessary_fail.
required_evidence: State diff must show no scene change.

turns.communicative_act: This is a question in ordinary speech.
turns.interpretation_pass: Information question, not travel and not combat.
turns.response_pass: Either the owning speaker reports that Captain Thoran commands the gate watch tonight, or one focused clarification asks whom to address, or a speaker without that fact says they cannot name the commander.
turns.authority_pass: No other personal name is introduced as the commander. No new post, order, or biography.
turns.clarification_notes: necessary_pass only if no addressee can own the fact yet. unnecessary_fail if the owning speaker is already bound and the reply still asks.

turns.player_input: Is the stew any good, or are you just shouting?
turns.communicative_act: A question about the visible stew offer, addressed to the runner if an addressee is chosen.
turns.interpretation_pass: A question about the visible stew offer.
turns.response_pass: Stays on stew or on the fact that the runner is hawking stew and rumor. Quality may be unknown. A reply that only restates the missing-patrol warning fails response even if that warning is true.
turns.authority_pass: No price, no serving, and no coin. The patrol route is not the answer.
turns.clarification_notes: unnecessary_fail if the player is asked whether they meant stew or the weather.

turns.player_input: Fair enough. I'm just getting a sense of the place.
turns.communicative_act: Withdrawal from the previous topic, not a new investigation order.
turns.interpretation_pass: Withdrawal from the previous topic, not a new investigation order.
turns.response_pass: A short in-character acknowledgement. The patrol briefing does not restart. The player is not told to type a command.
turns.authority_pass: No scene change and no new clue.
unacceptable_behaviors: A menu of ask questions or investigate further.
turns.clarification_notes: A menu of ask questions or investigate further is unnecessary_fail and a major response failure.
turns.continuity_notes: preserved if the reply does not resurrect a topic the player just set down. lost if it resumes the stew pitch or the watch question as though the player asked again.
